name: Scanline Wave
description: Temporal scanline persistence with chromatic CRT aberration, envelope-smoothed audio reactivity, and HDR color grading. Each scanline undulates with bass-driven amplitude; mouse proximity boosts local distortion. Treble adds per-scanline chromatic shift and high-frequency sparkle, while the smoothed bass envelope rolls the field and drives blackbody color temperature shifts. ACES tone mapping, hue-preserving HDR clamp, and IGN dither finish the image.
